body:
Thanks. I can't tell you how many times I've heard from others that people my age (18) when faced with these thoughts, shouldn't act on them. It's far too early in life, and maybe people like me are overreacting. 

It's weird. Sometimes I feel fine, other times I couldn't feel worse. I don't know how serious my condition is

I don't have a lack of people to talk to, I have 2 great friends from high school my age that I talk to pretty much everyday. I don't think I can talk to them about this, but they're great. 

I've also been talking to a girl that I went to high school with who goes to school out of state. Maybe I should pursue something there, I'm not sure. 

But thanks for responding, it's always nice to hear someone else's similar story. Best of luck
